label: Mould
description: Visible mould or damp marks that weaken presentation.
riskExplanation: Visible mould makes people question ventilation, maintenance and hygiene before they notice the rest of the property.
recommendedAction: Treat visible mould, clean wet areas deeply and restore the bathroom details that buyers, tenants and guests inspect first.

label: Odour
description: Stale, pet, smoke or tenancy smells.
riskExplanation: Smell is processed instantly. A stale or tenancy odour can make a clean-looking property feel untrusted.
recommendedAction: Find the odour source, deep clean soft surfaces and high-use zones, then deodorise for a fresher viewing or check-in moment.

label: Kitchen grease
description: Grease build-up on units, extractor, tiles or appliances.
riskExplanation: A greasy kitchen signals hard use and poor handover hygiene, even when other rooms look acceptable.
recommendedAction: Degrease appliances, tiles, extractor, units and touch points so the kitchen feels usable from day one.

label: Tired bathroom silicone
description: Dark, cracked or tired sealant around wet areas.
riskExplanation: Tired silicone makes wet areas look older, less hygienic and harder to trust during viewings.
recommendedAction: Refresh silicone, descale fixtures and detail-clean bathroom edges so the room feels cared for.

label: Carpet stains
description: Visible marks that pull down room presentation.
riskExplanation: Stained carpets make rooms feel inherited from the previous occupant and can imply wider tenant damage.
recommendedAction: Extract carpets and remove visible marks so photos and viewings feel fresher underfoot.

label: Dirty windows / frames
description: Frames, sills or glass making the property feel neglected.
riskExplanation: Dirty glass, frames and sills reduce natural light and make listing photos look duller than the property deserves.
recommendedAction: Detail-clean frames, sills and glass so rooms look brighter in photos and calmer during viewings.

label: Patio moss
description: Slippery or tired outdoor hard surfaces.
riskExplanation: Moss and algae weaken the arrival moment before people even step inside.
recommendedAction: Pressure wash patios, paths or driveways to make the entrance feel safer, cleaner and better maintained.

label: Wall marks
description: Scuffs, hand marks or tired high-traffic walls.
riskExplanation: Marked walls make rooms look tired in photos and suggest the property needs more work than it may actually need.
recommendedAction: Clean, touch up or refresh high-impact wall areas so rooms feel lighter and listing-ready.

label: Limescale
description: Heavy scale on taps, screens, shower heads or tiles.
riskExplanation: Limescale makes bathrooms and kitchens feel less clean, even after a standard clean.
recommendedAction: Descale fixtures, screens and wet-area details to restore a sharper hygiene signal.

label: Garden overgrowth
description: Outdoor areas reducing first impression and usability.
riskExplanation: Overgrowth makes a property feel unattended and can reduce confidence before the interior is seen.
recommendedAction: Cut back the key visible areas and reset entrance/garden presentation before photos or viewings.

label: Exterior grime
description: Entrance, paths or exterior details lowering first impression.
riskExplanation: A tired exterior makes prospects expect problems before the viewing has properly started.
recommendedAction: Clean the entrance, paths and high-visibility exterior details to recover the first impression.
